payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how different variants of ROUGE scores correlate with manual evaluations, indicating variability in their effectiveness.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
Among all variants of ROUGE, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in the context of scientific summarization.
The lowest F-score correlations are for ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L, indicating poor performance compared to other variants.
Keyword based reduction variants are the only variants for which the correlation with ROUGE is high.
